lines.en: label amimaidgen:
scene amimorninggen2
I arrive at the maid cafe and am promptly greeted by my [niece], who also happens to be the only maid working right now.
lines.zh: 我到了女仆咖啡厅，立刻被我的[侄女]迎了上来——她刚好也是现在唯一当班的女仆。

lines.en: And while this should probably worry me since she hasn't been doing this as long as someone like Uta, her confidence (And the fact that no one else is around) puts me at ease.
lines.zh: 她入行的时间远不如 Uta 那样久，本来该让我担心的；可她一脸自信（加上店里没别人），反倒让我安心了。

lines.en: Not having anything else to do at the moment, Ami stays at the table with me and talks a bit about how work has been going.
lines.zh: 眼下也没别的事，Ami 就留在桌边陪我，聊了聊工作近况。

lines.en: Apparently, she's only had a few male customers so far and every single one of them has shown more interest in Uta-chan than her, so of course I have to deal with those complaints for a little while.
lines.zh: 据说她目前只接待过几个男客人，而且每一个都更中意 Uta 酱，于是我当然得听她抱怨上好一阵子。

lines.en: How a maid cafe manages to stay open with predominantly female customers, I don't know. But it's nice knowing that no one's tried to take advantage of her.
lines.zh: 一家女仆咖啡厅靠女性为主的客人是怎么开下去的，我是不懂。不过知道没人占她便宜，感觉还不错。

lines.en: In fact, with the way she talks about it, I think she might even genuinely like this place.
lines.zh: 事实上，听她那口气，我觉得她是真心喜欢这地方的。

lines.en: Other than the whole {i}being apart from me{/i} thing, that is.
lines.zh: 除了「{i}要跟我分开{/i}」这件事之外。

lines.en: But hey, she had to leave the nest sometime. And now she's even making money by doing it.
lines.zh: 不过嘛，她总得离巢。而且现在靠这个还能赚钱。

lines.en: scene black
I decide to call it quits before I wind up spending all of my money.
lines.zh: 我决定在把钱花光之前收手。

lines.en: As it turns out, I am not only weak to Uta-chan, but to all maids in general.
lines.zh: 结果发现，我不光对 Uta 酱没抵抗力，对女仆这一类都没抵抗力。

lines.en: Ami was right. I may have an addiction.
lines.zh: Ami 说得对。我这大概是种瘾。

lines.en: How did I make it this far into life without realizing that?
lines.zh: 我是怎么活到今天都没发现这一点的？

lines.en: Before I'm able to make it out of the door, Ami hugs me from behind and tells me to come back soon-
lines.zh: 我还没走出门，Ami 就从背后抱住我，让我早点回来——

lines.en: Which would have been very cute if it weren't for the fact that she immediately followed that up with asking me to spend more money on her.
lines.zh: 这本来会非常可爱，如果不是她紧接着就要求我在她身上多花点钱的话。

lines.en: $ ami_love += 1
{i}Ami's affection has increased to [ami_love]!{/i}
jump saturdayafternoon
